d: Jis Iraq men sabse purani likhaee mili, jahan Babylon ke kanun bane aur Baghdad duniya ka gyan ghar tha... vo aaj itna badhal kaise ho gaya? is vidiyo men shubhankar mishra aapko Mesopotamia se 30 sitanbar 2026 tak ka pura saphar batate hain... Kushim ki takhti, Meluhha aur harappa ka rishta, ghari ke 60 minat ki jar, Gilgamesh ki barh vali kahani, Hammurabi ke kanun, Al-Khwarizmi aur bharat ke ank, 1258 men Mongol hamla, angrejon ke lie Mesopotamia bheje gae 5 lakh 88 hajar bhartiy, angrejon ka khincha naksha aur tel, Saddam Hussein ka uday, khun se likhi kuran ka kissa, Iran jang aur…
